capabilities: Push notes to the WeChat Official Account draft box
Upload local images referenced by the note
Copy formatted WeChat HTML to the clipboard
Store AppID and AppSecret account credentials
extras: Bilingual README (English and Chinese); direct draft pushing requires configuring an IP allowlist in the WeChat developer platform, while copying HTML works without credentials. Notes that the plugin reads the current note and its local images and writes to the clipboard but never reads the clipboard.
intentEvidence: 基于 RanceLee 的 WeChat Publisher 修改而来。
motivation: The README says it was modified from RanceLee's WeChat Publisher so articles can be typeset and published without leaving Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to format and publish articles to the WeChat Official Account platform, forcing writers to typeset outside the editor.

summary: WeChat publishing tool that formats notes with themes, previews them, and pushes them to a WeChat Official Account draft box or copies formatted HTML.
